status: S4 implementation exit satisfied; full S5 qualification remains unqualified
authority: Existing amended PM045 S4 table/GPI-S4 and ratified PM047; no new amendment

components.requirement: PTY byte/state preservation, hidden-render suppression and fair service
components.finding: Closed dock bypasses render snapshots while PTY/model processing continues; failed visible preparation restores consumed damage. Consolidated actual-native test retains hidden output/damage then reopens and presents. Existing fair scheduler/round tests pass in the app suite.

components.requirement: Serial shared-device multiwindow lifecycle; separate concurrent multi-device failure
components.finding: Actual X11/Vulkan Main plus Global, Project and New hosts present serially using one device; each owned host closes and Main resumes. This is bounded native implementation evidence, not desktop input, displayed pixels, backend/scale qualification or a fix for dat-gpu-test-concurrency-6dt.

components.requirement: All-host recovery and retained generation bounds
components.finding: Device replacement stages all hosts before publication, failure preserves prior state, and shared generation budgets survive resource replacement/close/recovery. Existing actual-native staged-failure receipts and GPU replacement evidence remain applicable to unchanged ownership; final app regression suite preserves recovery/queue tests. Complete fault/resource/time qualification remains S5.

components.requirement: AC-05 / HP08-03 capacities, shared/live/retiring ownership and exact upload accounting
components.finding: Stable allocation/generation and renderer identities distinguish requested extent/capacity, prepared/submitted references, consumer incidence, retirement and final release. Common submitted destination counters join host/attempt receipts; shared bytes count once. Existing document, control, shaped-text and scalar-cache owners cover retained CPU capacities. PM047 constructor/measurement completion supplies the final private allocation boundary. Observed snapshots and API bytes are not physical driver residency or a process-wide atomic snapshot.

Default mutation, raster, cold catalog/font creation, cache reconstruction and measurement use synchronous allocation-event windows with simultaneous host/process admission and per-call peaks. Existing reservations remain a floor. Retained catalog/database/output inputs are separated from new scratch. The guard refuses before scene/hit publication or GPU submission, releases derived cache work and preserves source/damage for retry. Datum-controlled staging remains pre-admitted under unchanged16/64MiB ceilings. Fixed call slots and reported Scope/registry storage complete guard bookkeeping; no dependency-layout introspection.

components.requirement: Exact changed-range transfers and shaping/layout dependency implementation
components.finding: Previously closed implementation predicates remain supported by existing readback, warm-zero transfer, identity and dependency evidence. Final measurement migration preserves actual library layout; guarded retry returns identical scenes and cached failures cannot become layout values.
